assets.name: banner-750x400.jpg
assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Draw ONE landscape, full-bleed illustration for a WeChat sticker album detail-page banner at 750 × 400 (15:8), no layout or panels. Reference images 1 and 2 are the SAME established character from this sticker album: use their likeness, hair shape and colors, ornament placement, costume, face and thick organic dark doodle outlines faithfully. GPT: long ivory/lilac-tinted hair, lavender eyes, two curved pale segmented horns and the separate gold flame-shaped ornament with a white-and-gold knotted flower on the viewer's right, tiny pale dragon wings, white dress with gold trim and wide detached white sleeves. Match the lively hand-inked little chibi with broad opaque color blocks and a few crayon highlights in the references. No typography, readable letters, numbers, signatures or watermark anywhere. Scene: At a sunlit hill of jade-green grass she runs down a slope and launches a folded golden paper glider; show the instant the plane rises into a vivid blue sky, its folded wing catching the light. A breeze sways a patch of yellow flowers and tugs her long ivory hair. Her small batlike wings remain attached to her back. Low rolling hills form a broad diagonal. Frame the single character large enough to recognize, with face, main prop and action fully inside the central 85% of the picture. Let background shapes fill all four sides. Give the image a rich colored opaque ground. Keep proportions natural, uncluttered silhouettes, one coherent moment, no white margin and no text.
assets.process: Proportional center crop to 750 × 400; JPEG quality 91, 4:4:4.

Match the lively hand-inked little chibi with broad opaque color blocks and a few crayon highlights in the references. No typography, readable letters, numbers, signatures or watermark anywhere. Pose: front-facing, happily lifting one long sleeve to cheek height, palm peeking out, a confident closed-mouth smile, both little dragon wings peeking out at the sides. assets.process: Trim transparent margins using alpha ≥ 8 with two source pixels of padding, scale proportionally with Lanczos3, center on transparent canvas.
